WITH order_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
type_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordertune,
    order_count,
    order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM order_type_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    order_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM type_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(order_count) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: The denominator for each share is the total distinct matched orders across all order types, and the overall average share is the unweighted average across order-type groups, including a NULL ordertune group when present.
